title: Promote your Party Plan business in this thread

posts.body:
This thread is for those of you who do party plan (BodyShop, Pampered Chef, Usbourne etc) to promote your business. Please do this here as opposed to promoting it in every thread - you can always link to this thread for members to get more details!
Guidelines:
Active members only - People who sign up just to promote themselves will find their posts deleted
Please mention the party plan you do and the area you cover at the top of your post.
Example:
[QUOTE FROM ANOTHER POST]
Quote:
Company: BodyShop at Home
Covering: Norfolk
Website:
www.example.com
Description here
[/QUOTE]
Please do not post your email address in posts, it encourages spammers and breaches your privacy. Ask members to PM you for further details or for your email address.

Company: Usborne Books at Home
Covering: team members europe wide!
Website:
www.childrensbooks4u.co.uk
I like usborne because I believe parents see books as a necessary purchase rather than a luxury or treat, Usborne have great ways to get yourself additional free books and the starting commission is great (24%).  I also think it has more earning potential than other party plan schemes as you can sell through so many places not just parties. I can also earn whilst i have my 2 children with me  😀 (i'm a sahm) which is such a bonus.  i sell through playgroups, softplay centers, parties, fayres, schools and nurseries.
I joined in june 06 and promoted to Team Leader after 3 months, i am really enjoying it and excited about the prospect of building a business so i never have to return to a 'proper' job!  😀  The group I am in has  over 90 organisers from all across Uk (and even into europe!) and we all have access to an online furum so there is a lot of experience and advice available,  there are also a lot of training documents which are a great help in getting started.
You purchase a starter kit (the kit changes monthly but is usually £38 for £100 worth of books/statioanry) which is all you need to get you going.  The only "catch" is you need to place £100 worth of orders within your first 12 weeks (you easily achieve this at your starter party)  The incentives are just that - they are not compulsery and are just a way of getting extra books for your kit and you off to a 'flying start'.  Commission starts at 24% and rises as your sales volume increases or if you build a team.
Please visit my website or you can email or pm me if you'd like an information pack.

Hello all
Yes I work for The Body Shop at Home.
But please let me tell you why. Up until last year I had a great job as a Head Receptionist in a large hotel lots of money and perks(Thats were I met my lovely husband!!) Then something happened that was a real change his 2 children came to live with us they were 5 and 7 at the time. After a couple of months juggerling shift work and children I gave up work to look after them as childcare was a nightmare(To expensive. could'nt find anyone etc etc ) I saw an advert for The Body Shop and thought I would give it a go and then get a proper job after the summer holidays.Did I get a job? no I did'nt, why? because I have a great job!!! I work my own hours earn great money and get to go away on lovely trips!!
I am an area manager now and still only work 10 hours a week how great is that.
So if you want to join me were ever you are England, Ireland, Scotland, or Whales get in touch we can have a chat and you to can do what I am doing and still go to School Plays,Parents Evenings and everything else the School and your children want you to come to.
Thanks

Hi,
My names Stacy and I'm an Independent Usborne Representative.
Do you love books? Then why not host an Usborne event and you could receive up to 20% of the total sales in free books. I am available for home parties, coffee mornings, parent & baby/toddler groups, fetes, fairs, open days, playgroups and many more.
Or maybe you want to work from home. Then read on, this could be just what you're looking for.
Do you love books? Then why not work from home as in Independent Usborne Representative selling award-winning Usborne Children’s books. You can sell to parents, schools, toddler groups,  friends, family, work colleagues, nurseries the list goes on.
You may choose to earn extra money around your current job and family or you may want to stay at home with your family but also to contribute to the family budget.
Lots of support and assistance will be provided to help you get started. Your starter kit cost's just £38, thats for £20 worth of stationary and £80 worth of books!
There are no sales targets, it’s your business and pretty much up to you how much or little you sell. There are 2 sales requirements, 1) is to place £100 order in the first 12 weeks, and 2) you have to place a £100 order in the period Sept-Dec. So nothing major really.
Commission starts at 24% and rises as your sales volume increases or if you build a team.
Enquiries are welcome, contact me for more details.
